markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (82%)** · Ambiguous: Invasive vs Benign · Careful review
Superior regions drive positive margins [F7], but the 90% conformal set retains Benign and InSitu [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 82%, Benign 9%, InSitu 6%, Normal 3% | Strong invasive lead |
| Conformal set | Benign, InSitu, Invasive (90% coverage) | Benign, InSitu not excluded |
| Reliability / OOD | 94% reliability, 78th percentile OOD [F6] | Typical, unflagged input |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Same top class | Foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 4/5 (80%) Invasive; 1/5 InSitu [F5] | Mostly invasive; InSitu mimic |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 0, 2, 3) · ↑ invasive · Top invasive driver [F2]; 19/20 AI spot-checked · Validated
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 0, 1, 4) · context · Upper-left immune infiltrate [F3]; 8/20 AI spot-checked · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 1, 2, 3) · ↑ invasive · Apparent mitotic push [F4]; 0/20 AI spot-checked · Unreliable
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Inferior benign signal; 0/20 AI spot-checked · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; removing top 3 risk regions drops invasive score above random (95% CI excludes 0, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unverified by deletion (95% CI includes 0); discount Unreliable mitoses (0/20), normal lobules (0/20), and necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Lymphocytes (regions 0, 1, 4) or frozen-section artifact mimic invasion around InSitu (like BACH_0165, 86% similar).
- Atypia stays duct-confined (region 7) or benign; drafted deeper levels test for in situ disease.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 1, 2, 3**: Confirm stromal invasion at superior (860 um), medial (323 um), and lateral (323 um) margins.
2. **Regions 4, 5, 6, 7**: Check mid-zone duct boundaries and lymphocytes to exclude Benign or InSitu.
3. **Regions 8, 9, 10, 11**: Confirm benign stroma, tubules, clear inferior margin (15%), and deeper-level need.
